summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 13 features: Create Document, Document Review & Approval workflow, Framework Workspace Link Document, Policy Coverage Summary, and AI Coverage Analysis. All 23 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features verified: Create Document mode with text editor form, Document Detail Panel with approval workflow bar (Draft→Under Review→Approved), Framework Workspace with Policy Coverage Summary bar showing X/Y controls with linked policies, Policies tab with Link Document button and document picker, Analyze button for AI coverage analysis.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 features fully implemented and tested. Key features: (1) Create Document mode in Upload & Map tab - shows text editor form with title input, content textarea, category selector, and Create Document button. Documents created have file_type='created' and status='draft'. (2) Document Detail Panel has approval workflow bar with Draft badge, Submit for Review button (transitions to under_review), Approve button (transitions to approved), and Reopen as Draft button. Created documents also have Edit Content button for editing content. (3) Framework Workspace has Policy Coverage Summary bar showing 'X of Y controls have linked policies (Z%)' with progress bar. (4) Policies tab in expanded control shows linked documents with Analyze button for AI coverage analysis and trash icon for unlinking. Link Document button opens picker showing all library docs and generated policies. (5) AI Coverage Analysis endpoint uses Emergent LLM Key (GPT-5.2) and returns coverage_score, coverage_level, addressed_requirements, gaps, and recommendation. Key endpoints: POST /api/documents/create, PUT /api/documents/{id}/status, PUT /api/documents/{id}/content, POST /api/control-compliance/{fw}/{ctrl}/link-document, DELETE /api/control-compliance/{fw}/{ctrl}/unlink-document/{id}, POST /api/control-compliance/{fw}/{ctrl}/analyze-coverage. Framework IDs are UUIDs (e.g., NIST SP 800-53 = 394b18c4-f22e-4b9a-984b-b5e2ec8143cb).
